name: Benin
note: Porto Novo is the capital; Cotonou is the seat of government.

name: Bolivia
note: Sucre is the constitutional capital; La Paz is the seat of government.

name: Switzerland
note: Bern is the federal city and the seat of the Federal Council and Federal Assembly.

name: Côte d’Ivoire
note: Yamoussoukro is the political capital; Abidjan remains a major administrative and economic centre.

name: Cyprus
note: Cyprus is assigned to Europe for this game. The Republic of Cyprus includes the north; British sovereign base areas are not game targets.

name: Equatorial Guinea
note: Ciudad de la Paz has replaced Malabo in the EU reference since 11 March 2026.

name: Indonesia
note: Jakarta follows the EU reference retrieved on 3 October 2026. The planned capital relocation to Nusantara is not treated as complete.

name: Israel
note: Jerusalem is the seat of government and parliament. The city’s status is disputed; this does not imply recognition of Israeli sovereignty over East Jerusalem.

name: Sri Lanka
note: Sri Jayawardenapura Kotte is the official capital and seat of parliament; Colombo remains a major government and economic centre.

name: Malaysia
note: Kuala Lumpur is the capital; Putrajaya is the seat of government.

name: Netherlands
note: Amsterdam is the capital; The Hague is the seat of government.

name: Nauru
note: Yaren is the seat of government; Nauru has no formally designated capital.

name: Palestine*
note: East Jerusalem is Palestine’s claimed capital; Ramallah is the administrative seat. The EU supports Jerusalem as the future capital of both states. Recognition varies among EU Member States.

name: Palau
note: Ngerulmud, in Melekeok State, is the seat of government. The EU table uses the shortened designation Melekeok; the marker follows the actual capitol location.

name: Russia
note: Russia is assigned to Europe in this game, although its territory also extends into Asia.

name: Sudan
note: Khartoum follows the EU reference; temporary wartime seats do not change this learning designation.

name: Eswatini
note: Eswatini has two capital functions: Mbabane (administrative) and Lobamba (royal and parliamentary).

name: Vatican City
note: The Holy See is a UN observer; the geographical game target is Vatican City State.

name: Kosovo*
note: Kosovo*: included on a status-neutral basis following EU terminology, without prejudice to positions on status, in line with UNSCR 1244/1999 and the ICJ opinion. Not all EU Member States recognise Kosovo.

name: Yemen
note: Sana’a follows the EU reference; capital status must be distinguished from changing actual seats of government during the conflict.

name: South Africa
note: South Africa has three capital functions: Pretoria (administrative), Cape Town (parliamentary) and Bloemfontein (judicial; seat of the Supreme Court of Appeal).
